title: Stored trade_crystal sold where it lies, at central_nexus, at 340 cr or more
note: 2026-11-17 23:42 UTC (Mercury, written by sellgen.py; orders block MERCURY, rule F24). central_nexus bid 352 x 8 (book of 2026-11-17T23:41:54Z); the cheapest ask read is 299 x 1000 at grand_exchange_station; floor 340 cr; 127 units lie there in our storages. requires.stored sends only a pilot whose own storage there holds the good; requires.bid closes the route while a book read within the hour shows no bid at the floor. The withdraw step takes only what the bid takes. Nothing is bought. Open to every division: each ship sells its own stores.
